figurative_meaning_en: To have an inner longing or desire; to be inclined towards something
similar_in_english: To have one's heart set on
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মন থাকছে দেশে ফিরে যাওয়ার।
example_sentences_in_english: He has his mind set on returning home.
I always have a desire to travel.
note: This idiom reflects the Bengali emphasis on inner emotional states in daily expression.
